puzzles.prompt: Fill in the missing words from this prophecy of the Messiah.
puzzles.text: But you, O [Bethlehem] Ephrathah, who are too little to be among the clans of Judah, from you shall come forth for me one who is to be [ruler] in Israel, whose coming forth is from of old, from [ancient] days.
puzzles.explanation: Written about 700 years before Jesus was born. The chief priests and scribes quoted it to Herod when the Magi asked where the Christ was to be born (Matthew 2:4-6).
